title: Change Cloud Password
description: Change the password for your current cloud wallet account. This generates new owner, active and memo keys from your new password and broadcasts an account_update operation.
targetAccountHint: This is the currently selected account whose password will be changed.
noUser: No user selected. Please select a BitShares account via the header account selector.
cloudWalletOnlyDesc: This tool is only for cloud wallet (password-derived) accounts. If you use a .bin wallet file, local wallet or private keys directly, do NOT proceed — changing the password here will not affect your .bin file and may make your account inaccessible.
cloudWalletCheckbox: I verify this is a cloud wallet account and not a .bin / local wallet account
beetWarningDesc: After the password change your BEET / BeetVault wallet will still be using the old password-derived keys and will fail to sign. You must remove the account from BEET/BeetVault and re-add it using the new password. Do not forget this step.
beetCheckbox: I understand I must remove and re-add the account in BEET/BeetVault after changing
memoWarningDesc: Changing the memo key means old encrypted memos will no longer be decryptable with the new password. Save your old memo private key first if you need to read historic memos.
memoCheckbox: I understand old memos will be unreadable unless I saved the old memo key
genPassAbout: This password was generated locally. No one but you has access to it. Copy it and store it safely before continuing.
passwordTooShort: Password should be at least 12 characters for security. Generated passwords are recommended.
derivedKeysDesc: Keys are derived as seed = accountName + role + password, using PrivateKey.fromSeed — same as account creation.
noKeys: Enter a valid password to preview keys.
loseAccess: I understand I will lose access to my funds if I lose my new password
noRecovery: I understand no one can recover my password if I lose it
writtenDown: I have written down or otherwise stored my new password
howItWorksBody: Your BitShares cloud password derives three keys. Changing the password replaces owner, active and memo keys in a single account_update operation.
